scope: Source-based editorial gameplay review of all nineteen original Crown & Kingdoms missions. Not a human or Xbox gameplay review; classifications are subjective.
referenceStandard: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition campaign design style, not a claim of exact historical mission or commercial content reproduction.
criteria: Distinct historical-style or original narrative arc
Varied objective paths with meaningful consequences
Real triggered encounters, allies, enemy counterplay and end conditions
Validated, fair and understandable player victory path

historicalValidation.note: From a prior revision, not retested on this review commit. One later isolated Causeway test still ended in defeat.

mostImportantIssues: Numerous stages are generic map + build/count/survive/destroy checklists
No truly hand-authored maps, multi-faction diplomacy or meaningful alternate objectives
Redwater and King's Road share the same win-condition skeleton
Five scripted defeats remain unsolved; positive setup and 40-second smoke tests are not evidence of full mission quality
Some objectives describe training or strategically located buildings but merely check living troop/building counts
Campaigns currently include no historical voiceover, hero-led escort storyline, or optional quests
changesInThisIteration: Raiders at the Ford: real five-unit royal relief guarded by the Town Centre at 445 seconds; objective wording now honestly says muster.
Crossing at Redwater: two physical trade carts follow a path toward the completed Market after minute 6:45.
Strait's Last Relic: actual hostile Monastery holding one real stolen relic, released after destruction.
Scripted events: mixed time + objective predicates now both gate an event, and events persist through saves.

missions.title: First Hearth
missions.finding: Controller-native economy lesson, but nearly all learning happens on a generic map.
missions.next: Add map-specific gathering tasks and staged reinforcement in later iteration.

missions.title: Raiders at the Ford
missions.finding: Raid waves are real; originally the promised royal relief did not arrive.
missions.next: Physical royal relief now arrives late; add a distinctive ford chokepoint.

missions.title: The Feudal Frontier
missions.finding: Checklist of age-ups, Market and Towers; real opposition starts near the conclusion.
missions.next: Stage frontier outposts and earlier reactive raids; test balance.

missions.title: The Relic Road
missions.finding: Real monk/relic interaction, but generic generated relic locations and a late raid.
missions.next: Add guarded relic sites and a distinct route choice.

missions.title: Siege of Kronburg
missions.finding: Starting rams and escort, real enemy Castle and Town Centre, clear unit counters.
missions.next: Add layered breach, side approach and castle response trigger.

missions.title: The Last Crown
missions.finding: Genuine King-protection loss and King-elimination victory, functioning garrison.
missions.next: Make rival King movement and escape routes a staged encounter.

missions.title: The Northern Watch
missions.finding: Feudal defence, natural production and multiple waves.
missions.next: Make the northern approaches physically distinct and reward holding outposts.

missions.title: Crossing at Redwater
missions.finding: Original goal set duplicated King's Road: Market, two Towers, eight-minute hold.
missions.next: A real merchant convoy now appears; next: meaningful escort goal and route geography.

missions.title: Crown of Ashford
missions.finding: Substantial starting army and hostile fortifications, but only one Town Centre objective.
missions.next: Add an intermediate gate breach or bridge-control objective.

missions.title: Siege of Greywatch
missions.finding: Paid replacement economy, ranged research, Guard escorts, proven scripted siege win.
missions.next: Add narrative objective stages and counterattacking enemy siege.

missions.title: The King's Road
missions.finding: Stone shortfall creates a trade/mining decision but resembles Redwater structurally.
missions.next: Turn it into a true road-supply mission with economic delivery target.

missions.title: The Reliquary Trail
missions.finding: Actual monk recovery and enemy patrols, but only a single goal.
missions.next: Introduce protected shrines and escort/relief choices.

missions.title: The Golden Coast
missions.finding: Mixed fleet and land objectives, but last isolated scripted run lost its Town Centre.
missions.next: Improve fleet preservation, staged enemy landings and a playable naval opening.

missions.title: The Strait's Last Relic
missions.finding: Large simultaneous relic and fortress goals; latest scripted run lost, and hostile abbey was absent.
missions.next: Enemy abbey now holds an actual captive relic; next verify recovery and balance.

missions.title: The Siege of Tidewatch
missions.finding: On 8 November, an isolated full battle with a proper five-House camp, two defensive watchtowers, staged Bombard Cannon muster and earned royal reserve lasted 614.4s and destroyed the enemy Dock and Castle, but the Town Centre was lost before the enemy capital fell.
missions.next: Improve actual defensive troop coordination, siege approach routes and late-stage counterattacks; prove a complete victory with the capital destroyed while keeping the real combat and resource rules.

missions.title: The Bridge at Blackwood
missions.finding: Walls and towers with several escalating raids are meaningful play.
missions.next: Make wall placement near the crossing count, not arbitrary distant walls.

missions.title: The Causeway Muster
missions.finding: Dock reconnaissance/paid construction now works, but the scripted player still loses and fleet survival is unstable.
missions.next: Rework harbour protection, land siege coordination and wave pacing.

missions.title: The Crown Holds the Crossing
missions.finding: Two Castles can be built anywhere despite the forward-crossings story; final assault loses.
missions.next: Use meaningful castle placement zones and guarded siege staging.

missions.title: The Iron Pass
missions.finding: Defender housing and escalating timed assaults are tested and meaningful.
missions.next: Add visible convoy exit and clear arrival cue for the finale.

replayVerification.mode: One-off CK_MISSION complete production-simulation replays, removed from ordinary focused CI after checking outcomes

missions.title: The Siege of Tidewatch
missions.notes: The optional harbour can be captured naturally; scripted player failed to preserve the artillery or complete the siege.

notes: The previously winning timed defence scenarios remain winnable after the new story encounters.
Strait's Last Relic still lacks a verified siege win and must not be presented as completed.
Separate focused tests verify the actual relief troop orders, merchant paths and enemy-owned relic release.
Full 19-mission campaign acceptance and physical Xbox Series S gameplay have not been rerun.
8 November Tidewatch full isolated simulation verified the optional harbour completion but still ended with Town Centre defeat at 514.4 simulated seconds.

tidewatchIteration.mode: One-off complete 30Hz scripted-player mission simulation; expensive probe removed from routine focused CI
tidewatchIteration.objectiveType: Bombard Cannon muster is now a milestone, not a maintained alive-count
tidewatchIteration.notes: Castle destruction and a longer siege are verified, but no natural victory has been proved. The failed scripted-player Guard experiments were reverted.
